text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Fine 
Motion wanted to deliver a run that would 
leave an unforgettable impact on 
everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she racks her brains, the Trainer tells 
her, "Just keep doing what you've always 
done." After all, her fans have always 
been captivated by the sheer joy in her 
running...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking that in, she directed a prayer-like 
wish to her fans, saying "don't forget 
me," as she headed into the race.
